relations.rationale: Checking in teams is unrelated to Ben joking with Gus during score tallying.
Checking in teams and announcing prize categories are separate, unrelated activities by Gia.
Gia performing check-in duties could contribute to a smoothly run evening, offering weak support.
Marking names on a clipboard has no bearing on Ben's height.
Marking names off a list is unrelated to Ben clapping during score reading.
Testing the microphone is a technical setup unrelated to the content of the announcement about round topics.
The round topic announcement has no bearing on Kai's past ranking.
Kai and Gus being in different houses doesn't relate to Ben joking with Gus about the picture round.

Kai and Gus being in different houses doesn't determine whether Esme and Gus are in different houses, though with only two houses it could be relevant, but house assignment for Esme is independent info.
Kai and Gus being in different houses implies there are at least two houses, supporting the claim there are two houses.
Kai and Gus's house assignments have no bearing on Esme's quiz-winning history.
Kai and Gus being in different houses doesn't affect Esme's determination to do well.
Being tall is a physical trait unrelated to being easygoing, a personality trait.
Ben's height has no bearing on him joking with Gus about the picture round.
Ben being tall has no bearing on Gus cheering at the final scores.
Ben's easygoing personality has no bearing on Esme and Gus's house assignments.

Ben's easygoing nature is unrelated to Gia's smiling from the front of the room.
Ben joking with Gus during score tallying and Kai mentioning his rank to Ben during a break are separate interactions, though both involve Ben, they describe different events without direct bearing.
Ben joking with Gus while waiting for scores is unrelated to Gus's later cheering when scores are read.
